verdict.rationale: Gusto supports one kind of recurring workflow: companies set pay schedules, which can differ by location or job type, and Gusto automatically pre-generates the scheduled regular payrolls for each pay period. The agent-oriented CLI also exposes a `gusto pay-schedule` command alongside per-cycle payroll prep. However, there is no evidence of a general mechanism to schedule arbitrary recurring jobs or automations; webhooks are event-triggered, not time-scheduled. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring job or workflow scheduling beyond payroll pay schedules, any API or agent-driven cron-style automation, independent corroboration.
